column1: # Hostile sizes for the robustness layer (tests/ex00/robust_rush.c).
# Nothing here is diffed against a rectangle: every case only has to come back
# alive, promptly, without burying the terminal. Labels are referenced by
# clues.tsv; rename one here and rename it there.
# --- part 1: sizes the subject leaves UNDEFINED -----------------------------
# "Your function must never crash or enter an infinite loop" is a requirement;
# what a non-positive size should PRINT is not specified, so it is not checked.
# A huge dimension is only ever paired with a non-positive one — rush(2147483647,
# 42) is 90 billion legitimate characters, not a bug.
# --- part 2: legal sizes that sit on a counter ceiling ----------------------
# These are perfectly valid rectangles — the value diff checks the ones up to
# 4097 — but a `char` counter stops at 127, an `unsigned char` at 255, a `short`
# at 32767, an `unsigned short` at 65535. Past its ceiling the counter wraps and
# the loop never ends, so here we only ask whether the call comes back at all.
# The last pair asks the same question of the call stack rather than a counter.
